		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_completed add = 1 }

		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved value = 0 }

	}

						TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						TICKET_STATE = $TICKET_STATE$
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }

				}
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }

				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					trigger_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
						var:zg361_pp_m186_operation_capacity_status = 1
					}
					trigger_else_if = {
						limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
						var:zg361_pp_m186_operation_capacity_status = 2
					}
					trigger_else = { always = yes }
					always = yes
					always = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_receipt_active value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }
				if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_goal_creep_lock value = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_evidence_led add = 1 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 2 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_goal_creep_lock value = 2 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_political add = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_deferred value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_policy_debt_due_days value = 90 }
					change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_policy_debt add = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { scope:zg361_pp_route = 3 } }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_object_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_object_subject value = this }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_object_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_object_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_object_state value = 3 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_baseline_workload value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_current_workload value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_replacement_workload value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_deadline_extension_days value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_goal_creep_violation value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_workload_truth_status value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_workload_red_code value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_manager_workload_route value = scope:zg361_pp_route }

				}

				zg361_pp_m186_consume_effect = yes
				zg361_pp_m186_schedule_audit_1_effect = yes
				set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

zg361_pp_m186_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_w_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_w_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_w_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_w_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_w_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_w_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = var:zg361_pp_m186_receipt_owner
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = var:zg361_pp_m186_receipt_subject
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = var:zg361_pp_m186_receipt_cycle
				EXPECTED_CASE = var:zg361_pp_m186_receipt_case
				EXPECTED_STATE = var:zg361_pp_m186_receipt_state
			}
			var:zg361_pp_m186_receipt_active = 1
			var:zg361_pp_m186_consumed = 0
			has_variable = zg361_pp_m186_route
			always = yes
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m186_route = 3 } }
				has_variable = zg361_pp_m186_goal_creep_lock
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_consumed value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_consumer_revision value = var:zg361_case_w_revision }

		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:zg361_pp_m186_route = 3 } } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_consumer_value value = var:zg361_pp_m186_goal_creep_lock } }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_completed add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition value = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_available }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_reserved }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_partition add = var:zg361_pp_w_operation_capacity_settled }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved value = 0 }
		if = { limit = { var:zg361_pp_w_resource_partition = var:zg361_pp_w_authorized } set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_w_resource_conserved value = 1 } }

		zg361_pp_w_try_advance_03_effect = yes
	}
}

zg361_pp_m186_schedule_audit_1_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m186_audit_1_state = 0 var:zg361_pp_m186_receipt_active = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_audit_1_owner value = var:zg361_case_w_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_audit_1_subject value = this }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_audit_1_cycle value = var:zg361_case_w_cycle_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_audit_1_case value = var:zg361_case_w_case_serial }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_audit_1_expected_state value = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_pp_m186_audit_1_state value = 1 }
		if = {
		limit = { var:zg361_pp_m186_route = 3 }
		trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2186 days = 90 }
	}
	else = { trigger_event = { id = zg361pp.2186 days = 7 } }
	}
}
